verdict.rationale: A hands-on community comment says AnythingLLM itself supports TTS/STT, which points to transcribed voice input and spoken replies. First-party docs only describe local meeting transcription, which is a related audio feature rather than conversational voice interaction. missing for 10: first-party documentation of voice-note transcription in chat, spoken (TTS) replies, live voice conversation mode, and independent corroboration of voice chat depth.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported

citations.quote: it supports embedding models, vector databases, and TTS/STT, everything needed to build a fully functioning voice chatbot
Automatically transcribes and summarizes any meeting entirely on your computer.
